seo.metaTitle: Link & text cleaner — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Paste text or links to remove tracking parameters (such as utm, fbclid and gclid), strip invisible characters, and optionally mask email addresses or secret keys. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/crypto/clean-paste-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Link & text cleaner processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/clean-paste-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Link & text cleaner upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Link & text cleaner executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/crypto/clean-paste-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Link & text cleaner upload my files or text to a server?

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Link & text cleaner?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/clean_paste.json or open /tools/clean-paste?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
